source: TFT Data Dragon 16.21.1 (noxelisdev/TFT_DDragon); tiers: PivotTFT Set 18 / patch 18.6 snapshot

entries.name: Advanced Loan
entries.description: Gain 20 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

entries.name: Advanced Loan+
entries.description: Gain 33 Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

entries.name: Arcane Viktor-y
entries.description: After 8 seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for 1.5 seconds. Repeat this after 18 seconds of combat. TFT Macao Open, 2024

entries.name: Ascension
entries.description: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 35% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Augmented Power
entries.description: Your next augment is one tier higher.

entries.name: Backline Blueprint
entries.description: Gain a 3-cost non-Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

entries.name: Backup Bows
entries.description: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack 1000 times, get 2 more.

entries.name: Band of Thieves
entries.description: Gain 1 Thief's Gloves.

entries.name: Band of Thieves II
entries.description: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

entries.name: Band of Thieves II+
entries.description: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 5 player combats, gain another.

entries.name: Band of Thieves II++
entries.description: Gain 2 Thief's Gloves. After 3 player combats, gain another.

entries.name: Baron's Lair
entries.description: Gain a random Tank item. After 8 seconds of combat, your team gains 4% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat. TFT Paris Open, 2025

entries.name: Beast Within
entries.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi now and a Nidalee after 3 rounds.

entries.name: Beast Within+
entries.description: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Nidalee.

entries.name: Belt Overflow
entries.description: Gain 4 Giant's Belts. Your Giant's Belts grant +85 bonus Health.

entries.name: Big Grab Bag
entries.description: Gain 3 random components, 2 gold, and 1 Reforger.

entries.name: Birthday Present
entries.description: Gain a 2-star champion and 1 gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus 4 (max: 5-cost).

entries.name: Birthday Reunion
entries.description: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion. At Level 6, gain a random item component. At Level 9, gain a random 2-star 5-cost champion. Inkborn Fables Tactician's Crown, 2024

entries.name: Blossom's Call
entries.description: When you buy a Wisp, gain a random Blossom champion based on the Wisp's cost. Gain a Yunara, a Yorick, and a Karma.

entries.name: Bodyguard Training
entries.description: Allies gain 15 Armor and Magic Resist, increased by 2 per player level. Gizmos & Gadgets Championship, 2022

entries.name: Bonus Gifts
entries.description: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 25% chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 1 gray loot orbs.

entries.name: Bonus Gifts+
entries.description: Whenever you open a loot orb, you have a 25% chance to gain a gray loot orb. Gain 2 gray loot orbs.

entries.name: Booster Pack
entries.description: Gain 12 gold of random champions. (At least one 3-cost guaranteed!)

entries.name: Booster Pack+
entries.description: Gain 18 gold of random champions. (At least one 4-cost guaranteed!)

entries.name: Booster Pack++
entries.description: Gain 26 gold of random champions. (At least one 5-cost guaranteed!)

entries.name: Boxing Lessons
entries.description: Your team gains 30 Health for each champion that starts combat in the front row.

entries.name: Branching Out
entries.description: Gain a random Emblem.

entries.name: Branching Out+
entries.description: Gain a random Emblem and a Reforger.

entries.name: Bronze For Life I
entries.description: Your team gains 2.5% Damage Amp for each Bronze-tier trait.

entries.name: Bronze For Life II
entries.description: Your team gains 2.5% Damage Amp and 2.5 Armor and Magic Resist for each Bronze-tier trait.

entries.name: Build A Bud
entries.description: Gain a random 3-star 1-cost champion. Gain 9 gold.

entries.name: Buried Treasures III
entries.description: Gain a random item component now and at the start of the next 6 rounds.

entries.name: Calculated Loss
entries.description: After losing your combat, gain 2 gold and a free Shop reroll.

entries.name: Call To Chaos
entries.description: Gain a powerful and random reward.

entries.name: Called Shot
entries.description: Set your win streak to +4. Gain 4 gold.

entries.name: Capital Gains I
entries.description: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 100% of the stored gold. Gain 1 gold now.

entries.name: Capital Gains II
entries.description: Store gold equal to the interest you earn. On 3-3, gain gold equal to 125% of the stored gold. Gain 3 gold now.

entries.name: Caretaker's Ally
entries.description: Gain a random 2-cost champion now. Gain the same one again every time you level up. Champion: 0

entries.name: Caretaker's Favor
entries.description: Gain a component anvil when you reach level 5, 6, 7, and 8. Component anvils offer 4 choices.

entries.name: Carve a Path
entries.description: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal 65000 physical damage, gain 2 more.

entries.name: Celestial Blessing I
entries.description: Your team gains 12% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 200 Health.

entries.name: Celestial Blessing II
entries.description: Your team gains 18% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 400 Health.

entries.name: Celestial Blessing III
entries.description: Your team gains 25% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to 1000 Health.

entries.name: Champ Delivery
entries.description: Gain 3 2-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

entries.name: Champ Delivery+
entries.description: Gain 3 3-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

entries.name: Champ Delivery++
entries.description: Gain 3 4-cost champions. After 6 rounds, gain 3 more.

entries.name: Chosen of the Sun
entries.description: Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Sejuani. Leona gains 70 permanent max Health each round, increased by 10 for each unique 3-star champion fielded.

entries.name: Clear Mind
entries.description: If there are no champions on your bench at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

entries.name: Clockwork Accelerator
entries.description: Your team gains 10% Attack Speed every 3 seconds in combat.

entries.name: Cluttered Mind
entries.description: Gain 4 1-cost champions now. If your bench is full at the end of player combat, gain 3 XP.

entries.name: Cognitive Overload
entries.description: Gain 7 gold, 1 2-star 1-cost champion, 1 2-cost champion, 2 3-cost champions, 1 XP, and 1 Shop reroll.

entries.name: Cognitive Tax
entries.description: Gain 8 gold and 1 XP.

entries.name: Cognitive Tax+
entries.description: Gain 12 gold and 3 XP.

entries.name: Comeback Story
entries.description: Your team gains 4 Health and 0.3% Attack Speed per missing player Health.

entries.name: Commerce Core
entries.description: Gain 16 free Shop rerolls now and 3 every round for the rest of the game.

entries.name: Component Buffet
entries.description: Whenever you would get a component, gain a component anvil instead. Gain a random component.The anvil offers 4 choices.

entries.name: Component Quest
entries.description: Gain a random component and 1 gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain 1 gold.

entries.name: Construct a Companion
entries.description: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 2 gold.

entries.name: Consuming Flora
entries.description: Gain a Flora Fatalis emblem. The champion holding the emblem gains 70% increased benefits from Flora Fatalis. Gain 3 gold.

entries.name: Cooking Pot
entries.description: At the start of each turn, all allies holding a Frying Pan or Spatula item grant the nearest champion 70 permanent Health. Gain a Frying Pan.

entries.name: Coronation
entries.description: Gain a Tactician's Crown. Tactician's Crown, Cape, and Shield grant the holder 20% Attack Speed, 25% Attack Damage, and 30% Ability Power.

entries.name: Corrosion
entries.description: Enemies in the first two rows lose 4 Armor and Magic Resist every 2 seconds.

entries.name: Coven Acolyte
entries.description: When you choose to continue gathering Coven essence, heal 2 Tactician health. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

entries.name: Crafted Crafting
entries.description: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain 2 rerolls.

entries.name: Cry Me A River
entries.description: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. Your team gains 1 Mana Regen. After 12 seconds in combat, increase this to 3.

entries.name: Cybernetic Implants
entries.description: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 15% Attack Damage. Gain a B.F. Sword.

entries.name: Cybernetic Uplink
entries.description: Your champions holding an item gain 100 Health and 2 Mana Regen. Gain a Tear of the Goddess.

entries.name: Dark Ritual
entries.description: Converting Coven Essence to rewards grants Coven champions Ability Power instead of loot. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

entries.name: Deadlier Blades
entries.description: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain 1% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

entries.name: Deadlier Caps
entries.description: Gain a Rabadon's Deathcap. Rabadon's Deathcaps grant 1 Mana Regen and permanently gain 1% Ability Power whenever their holders score a takedown.

entries.name: Dummify
entries.description: Lose all champions on your board and bench. Gain a Training Dummy with 60% of their combined health. The dummy gains 1150 Health per stage. Gain a random non-tank 2-star 2 cost champion.

entries.name: Duo Queue
entries.description: Gain 2 random 5-cost champions and 2 copies of a random component.

entries.name: Early Learnings
entries.description: Your team gains 3% Attack Damage & Ability Power. This increases by 1% after each player combat. 1-cost champions gain double.

entries.name: Electrocharge I
entries.description: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 25-80 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

entries.name: Electrocharge II
entries.description: Every 4 attacks an ally takes, they deal 50-140 (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (1 second cooldown).

entries.name: Embiggen
entries.description: Fae pixies are now larger and grant 50% more Attack Damage and Ability Power. Fae champions gain 18% Attack Damage and Ability Power immediately. Gain a Xayah and a Rakan.

entries.name: Epic Rolldown
entries.description: When you reach Level 8, gain 20 Shop rerolls. Runeterra Reforged Championship, 2023

entries.name: Epoch
entries.description: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 4 XP and 2 free rerolls.

entries.name: Epoch+
entries.description: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain 8 XP and 2 free rerolls.

entries.name: Exclusive Customization
entries.description: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and 7 gold.

entries.name: Expected Unexpectedness
entries.description: Now and at the start of the next 2 stages, roll 3 dice. Gain various rewards based on their total.

entries.name: Expedition
entries.description: At the start of every round, lose the champion in the rightmost bench slot. After losing 33 gold of champions in this way, gain a powerful reward. Gain a 3-cost champion now.

entries.name: Explosive Growth
entries.description: Now and at the start of the next 3 rounds, gain 7 XP.

entries.name: Explosive Growth+
entries.description: Now and at the start of the next 3 rounds, gain 9 XP.

entries.name: Extra Buckles
entries.description: Gain a Giant's Belt. After your champions take 75000 damage, get 2 more.

entries.name: Feeling Lucky
entries.description: Gain 12 gold, then flip a coin. If heads, gain 4 more gold.

entries.name: Find Your Center
entries.description: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains 15% Damage Amp and 25% max Health.

entries.name: Flame On
entries.description: Your 1 and 2-cost Inferno champions gain 0.2 Attack Damage and Ability Power. The one who did the most damage last combat gains double. Gain a Varus and an Akali.

entries.name: Flexible
entries.description: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains 30 Health for each Emblem they are holding.

entries.name: Flowing Tears
entries.description: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend 7000 Mana, gain 2 more.

entries.name: Focused Fire
entries.description: Your team gains 10% Attack Damage. Every 5 seconds, they gain 5% more.

entries.name: Forge A Friend
entries.description: The next 1-cost champion you buy is 3-star. Gain 5 gold.

entries.name: Forged In Strength
entries.description: Gain 1 random Artifact. When you drop below 35 Health, gain 1 more random Artifact, 1 random completed item, and 2 random components. Remix Rumble Championship, 2023

entries.name: FOURcing
entries.description: Gain a random 4-cost champion. For each item equipped to that champion, your team gains 100 health.

entries.name: Frontline Foundation
entries.description: Gain a 2-star 1-cost Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

entries.name: Future Focused
entries.description: Your Tactician loses 20 Health, but after 5 player combats, gain 3 4-cost champions and 5 gold.

entries.name: Gain 21 Gold
entries.description: Gain 21 gold.

entries.name: Giant and Mighty
entries.description: Your team becomes large, gaining 225 Health and 10% max Health.

entries.name: Gilded Steel
entries.description: Gain two 5-cost champions. If you field at least one 5-cost champion, your 1 to 4-cost champions gain 8% Durability. K.O. Coliseum Tactician's Crown, 2025

entries.name: Glass Cannon I
entries.description: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 16% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Glass Cannon II
entries.description: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at 80% Health but gain 25% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Going Long
entries.description: You no longer gain interest. Gain 10 gold now. Gain 4 XP after every player combat. Interest is extra gold you gain per 10 g saved.

entries.name: Gold Destiny
entries.description: Gain a random Gold Augment and 3 gold.

entries.name: Gold Destiny+
entries.description: Gain a random Gold Augment and 5 gold.

entries.name: Golden Gamble
entries.description: Gain 2 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

entries.name: Golden Gamble+
entries.description: Gain 3 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

entries.name: Golden Gamble++
entries.description: Gain 6 gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain 2 Completed Item anvils.

entries.name: Good For Something I
entries.description: Champions that aren't holding items have a 40% chance to drop 1 gold on death.

entries.name: Group Hug I
entries.description: Combat start: Champions grant other adjacent champions 7 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

entries.name: Group Hug II
entries.description: Combat start: Champions grant other adjacent champions 10 Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

entries.name: Hard Bargain
entries.description: You cannot choose your Carousel rewards. Gain an additional 6 player health and 8 gold each carousel round. When you do not pick a Carousel Reward, you are given an unpicked champion and the item it carries.

entries.name: Hard Commit
entries.description: Gain a random emblem. Now and at the start of each stage, gain a 1-star champion of that trait with a cost equal to the Stage (max 5) and 3 gold.

entries.name: Healing Orbs I
entries.description: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for 250 Health.

entries.name: Healing Orbs II
entries.description: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for 575 Health.

entries.name: Hedge Fund
entries.description: Gain 22 gold. Your max interest is increased to 10.

entries.name: Heroic Grab Bag
entries.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 6 gold.

entries.name: Heroic Grab Bag+
entries.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 8 gold.

entries.name: Heroic Grab Bag++
entries.description: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain 14 gold.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries.description: Champions in your back 2 rows gain 11% Ability Power and 11% Attack Damage for each champion that starts combat in your front row.

entries.name: Hustler
entries.description: You no longer gain interest but gain 3 gold at the start of every player combat round. Gain 3 gold now. Interest is extra gold you gain per 10 g saved.

entries.name: Infinity Protection
entries.description: Gain 3 gold now. On Stage 3-7, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a 12% Health shield. Monsters Attack Championship, 2023

entries.name: Invested+
entries.description: Gain 26 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

entries.name: Invested++
entries.description: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

entries.name: Investment Strategy I
entries.description: Your champions gain 9 permanent max health per interest you earn. Gain 3 gold now.

entries.name: Investment Strategy II
entries.description: Your champions gain 12 permanent max health per interest you earn. Your max interest is increased by 2. Gain 6 gold now.

entries.name: Iron Assets
entries.description: Gain a component anvil and 3 gold.

entries.name: It's Me, Baby
entries.description: Gain a championship hex in the bottom right corner. The champion in it gains 15% Damage Amp and 15% Attack Speed, and drops 1 gold every 5 takedowns. Lore & Legends Tactician's Crown, 2026

entries.name: Item Extraction
entries.description: The first 3 times you sacrifice a champion in the Blackthorn hex, gain a copy of a random component they're holding. Gain an Azir and a Rek'Sai.

entries.name: Item Grab Bag I
entries.description: Gain 1 random completed item.

entries.name: Jeweled Lotus I
entries.description: Your team gains 15% Critical Strike Chance and Precision. Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Additional Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

entries.name: Jeweled Lotus II
entries.description: Your team gains 25% Critical Strike Chance, 10% Critical Strike Damage, and Precision . Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Additional Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

entries.name: Kick Start
entries.description: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion and 1 gold.

entries.name: Kingslayer
entries.description: After winning player combat, gain 1 gold. If they had more health than you, gain 6 Gold instead. Gain 1 gold.

entries.name: Know Your Enemy
entries.description: You can see who you will fight next. Your team gains 8% Damage Amp, increased to 15% if you and your opponent have any of the same traits active.

entries.name: Late Game Scaling
entries.description: Gain 2 XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain 12% Health and 12% Attack Speed. Cyber City Tactician's Crown, 2025

entries.name: Late Game Specialist
entries.description: When you reach Level 9, gain 27 gold.

entries.name: Latent Forge
entries.description: After 8 player combats, gain an Artifact anvil.

entries.name: Legion Of Threes
entries.description: Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain 150 Health and 12% Attack Speed. Reckoning Championship, 2021

entries.name: Level Up!
entries.description: When you buy XP, gain an additional 2. Gain 10 immediately.

entries.name: Living Forge
entries.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil now and after every 10 player combats.

entries.name: Loaded Dice
entries.description: Your dice and coins are luckier. Roll a die and gain gold equal to the number rolled. Then flip a coin and gain 1 gold if you flip heads.

entries.name: Lucky Gloves
entries.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves and 4 gold.

entries.name: Lucky Gloves+
entries.description: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain 2 Sparring Gloves now, then another after 4 player combats.

entries.name: Luxury Subscription
entries.description: Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and 5 gold. At the start of the next 2 stages, gain the package again.

entries.name: Magic Roll
entries.description: Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

entries.name: Makeshift Armor I
entries.description: Champions without items equipped gain 30 Armor and Magic Resist.

entries.name: Makeshift Armor II
entries.description: Champions without items equipped gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist.

entries.name: Malicious Monetization
entries.description: Gain 6 gold. For the next 2 rounds, enemy champions drop 2 gold when killed.

entries.name: Master of All Origins
entries.description: Open an armory and choose one of 3 traits. Gain a Lux with that trait and a Spear of Shojin. Traits on your board are more likely to appear in the armory. Lux provides +2 to her chosen trait

entries.name: Max Build
entries.description: Gain 10 free Shop rerolls. When you reach level 9, gain 3 free Shop rerolls and a Champion Duplicator. Galaxies Championship, 2020

entries.name: Min-Max
entries.description: Gain a Golden Item Remover, 4 random components, and 4 gold.

entries.name: Missed Connections
entries.description: Gain a copy of each 1-cost champion.

entries.name: Money Hungry
entries.description: Gain 7 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

entries.name: Money Hungry+
entries.description: Gain 13 gold now, then 7 gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

entries.name: Money Monsoon
entries.description: Gain 7 gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

entries.name: Nature's Shelter
entries.description: Champions that start combat adjacent to an Elderwood plant gain 15% Attack Speed and heal 2% of their maximum Health every 2 seconds. Gain an Alistar, an Ornn, and a Xayah.

entries.name: Nesting Anvils
entries.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 6 gold.

entries.name: Nesting Anvils+
entries.description: Gain an Artifact Anvil. After you open it, gain a Component Anvil. After you open that, gain 8 gold.

entries.name: NO SCOUT NO PIVOT
entries.description: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains 1% Health, and 1% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

entries.name: Omega Riftbeast
entries.description: You can now choose a second Alpha Riftbeast. Alpha Riftbeasts gain 8% max Health and 8% Attack Speed. Gain a Scuttlecrab, a Cinderling, and a Pebbles.

entries.name: One Buff Two Buff
entries.description: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

entries.name: One, Two, Five!
entries.description: Gain 1 random component, 2 gold, and 1 random 5-cost champion.

entries.name: Ones Two Three
entries.description: Gain 2 1-cost champions, 1 2-cost champion, and 1 3-cost champion.

entries.name: Pandora's Bench
entries.description: At the start of every round, champions on the 3 rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain 1 gold.

entries.name: Pandora's Items I
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 random component.

entries.name: Pandora's Items II
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 2 random components and 1 gold.

entries.name: Pandora's Items II+
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 2 random components and 4 gold.

entries.name: Pandora's Items II++
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 2 random components and 6 gold.

entries.name: Pandora's Items III
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain 1 Radiant item.

entries.name: Partial Ascension
entries.description: After 12 seconds of combat, your units gain 20% Damage Amp.

entries.name: Patience Is A Virtue
entries.description: Gain 5 rerolls now. Each round, gain 1 free reroll if you did not buy a champion last round.

entries.name: Patient Study
entries.description: After player combat, gain 2 XP if you won or 3 XP if you lost.

entries.name: Pilfer
entries.description: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain 21 gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves.

entries.name: Plot Armor
entries.description: Your team gains 8 Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below 50% Health, increase this to 40 for the rest of combat.

entries.name: Portable Forge
entries.description: Choose 1 of 4 Artifacts. Artifacts are more powerful items with a unique effect.

entries.name: Prismatic Destiny
entries.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 2 gold.

entries.name: Prismatic Destiny+
entries.description: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and 7 gold.

entries.name: Prismatic Ticket
entries.description: Each time your shop is rerolled you have a 45% chance to gain a free reroll.

entries.name: Promised Protection
entries.description: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder 20% additional Mana from all sources and 175 max Health.

entries.name: Quick Streaks
entries.description: You gain twice as much progress towards win and loss streaks. Gain 2 gold.

entries.name: Radiant Rascal
entries.description: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

entries.name: Radiant Relics
entries.description: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

entries.name: Recombobulator
entries.description: Champions on your board permanently transform into random champions 1 cost tier higher (max 5). Gain 2 Magnetic Removers and 3 free rerolls.

entries.name: Replication
entries.description: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next 2 rounds, gain a copy of that component.

entries.name: Residual Magic
entries.description: Your team gains 60 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

entries.name: Residual Magic +
entries.description: Your team gains 75 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

entries.name: Residual Magic ++
entries.description: Your team gains 90 Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by 10.

entries.name: Retribution
entries.description: Gain 2 Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and 15% Critical Strike Chance. Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Additional Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

entries.name: Rolling For Days
entries.description: Gain 10 free Shop rerolls.

entries.name: Salvage Bin
entries.description: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 8 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

entries.name: Salvage Bin+
entries.description: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after 4 player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

entries.name: Seraphim's Staff
entries.description: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants 2 additional Mana Regen if its holder has 110% or more Ability Power.

entries.name: Shimmerscale Essence
entries.description: Gain a Gambler's Blade. After 6 player combats, gain a Mogul's Mail.

entries.name: Shopping Spree
entries.description: When you level up, gain a number of Shop refreshes equal to your level +1. Gain 6 gold.

entries.name: Silver Destiny
entries.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 2 gold.

entries.name: Silver Destiny+
entries.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 4 gold.

entries.name: Silver Destiny++
entries.description: Gain a random Silver Augment and 7 gold.

entries.name: Silver Spoon
entries.description: Gain 10 XP.

entries.name: Slammin'
entries.description: Gain 3 gold. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

entries.name: Slammin'+
entries.description: Gain 4 gold and 10 XP now. After each player combat, if there are no items on your bench (other than consumables), gain 2 XP.

entries.name: Slice of Life
entries.description: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving 1 5-cost champion.

entries.name: Slightly Magic Roll
entries.description: Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

entries.name: Small Furry Friend
entries.description: While Sprykin is active, gain a second BFF summon that is 45% as powerful. Gain a Teemo, a Veigar, and a Kobuko.

entries.name: Small Grab Bag
entries.description: Gain 2 random item components.

entries.name: Solo Leveling
entries.description: For the next 5 combats, your team size is 1, but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain 1 XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain 2 item components.

entries.name: Solo Plate
entries.description: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain 17% max Health if they start combat alone in their row.

entries.name: Soul Awakening
entries.description: Combat start: Your team gains 1.5% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for 10 seconds. At max stacks, deal 12% bonus true damage.

entries.name: Speedy Double Kill
entries.description: Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain 40 gold. Fates Championship, 2021

entries.name: Spirit Of Redemption
entries.description: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every 5 seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within 1 hex for 9% of their missing Health.

entries.name: Spreading Roots
entries.description: Gain a random Emblems. After 3 combats, gain another.

entries.name: Spreading Roots+
entries.description: Gain 2 random Emblems and 2 gold.

entries.name: Staffsmith
entries.description: Gain 2 random completed items that build from Needlessly Large Rod.

entries.name: Stand United
entries.description: Your units gain 1.5% Attack Damage and 1.5% Ability Power for each non-unique Trait active across your team.

entries.name: Sun and Moon
entries.description: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and a Diana.

entries.name: Sun and Moon+
entries.description: Your Lunar champions gain 100 Health and 8% Damage Amp for each unique Solar champion fielded. Gain a Leona, a Kayle, and an Aphelios.

entries.name: Sweet Treats
entries.description: Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains 16 Health for each item equipped on champions.

entries.name: Sword Overflow
entries.description: Gain 4 BF Swords. Your BF Swords grant +4% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Swordsmith
entries.description: Gain 2 random completed items that build from B.F. Sword.

entries.name: Tactician's Kitchen
entries.description: Gain a random Emblem. After 3 rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

entries.name: Team Building
entries.description: Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator. Gain another after 5 player combats. This item allows you to copy a 3-cost or less champion.

entries.name: The Golden Dragon
entries.description: Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up +1 team slot but gain 600 Health and 15% Durability. Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power. Dragonlands Championship, 2022

entries.name: The Golden Egg
entries.description: Gain a golden egg that hatches in 11 turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

entries.name: The Tower
entries.description: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every 4 seconds, it zaps the 3 nearest enemies dealing 5% max Health true damage.

entries.name: The Trait Tree
entries.description: Gain 3 random Emblems and 2 gold.

entries.name: The Trait Tree+
entries.description: Gain 3 random Emblems, a Reforger, and 4 gold.

entries.name: Time Skip
entries.description: Disable your Shop for the next 3 rounds. Then gain 32 XP.

entries.name: Tons of Stats!
entries.description: Your team gains 44 Health, 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 4 Armor, 4 Magic Resist, 4% Attack Speed, and 4 Mana.

entries.name: Trade Sector
entries.description: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 2 gold.

entries.name: Trade Sector+
entries.description: Gain a Shop reroll every round. Gain 8 gold.

entries.name: Trait Ladder
entries.description: Gain a random emblem. After fielding 2 non-unique traits in a player combat, gain a reward. Then increase the number of traits needed and the size of the reward.

entries.name: Twin Guardians
entries.description: If you have exactly 2 allies in your first row, grant them 100 Health, 35 Armor, and 35 Magic Resist.

entries.name: U.R.F
entries.description: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain 20% Attack Speed and 3 Mana Regen.

entries.name: Unrivaled
entries.description: You can field Rengar and Kha'Zix together with no penalties, and they gain bonuses when the other casts. Gain a Rengar and a Kha'Zix.

entries.name: Upward Mobility
entries.description: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain 2 Health and 2 Shop rerolls whenever you level up.

entries.name: Urf's Grab Bag
entries.description: Gain 1 Spatula, 3 random components, and 5 gold.

entries.name: Verticality I
entries.description: Champions gain 1.5% Attack Damage, 1.5% Ability Power, 1.5 Armor, and 1.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

entries.name: Verticality II
entries.description: Champions gain 2.5% Attack Damage, 2.5% Ability Power, 2 Armor, and 2 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

entries.name: Verticality III
entries.description: Champions gain 4% Attack Damage, 4% Ability Power, 3.5 Armor, and 3.5 Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

entries.name: Wand Overflow
entries.description: Gain 4 Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +5% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Warpath
entries.description: Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing 80 player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.

entries.name: We Stick Together
entries.description: Gain an Emblem of a random trait and a completed item anvil. Allies with that trait gain 30% Attack Speed. 0 0 Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025

entries.name: Weight The Worth
entries.description: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator.

entries.name: Wisp Rebate
entries.description: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 4 gold now.

entries.name: Wisp Rebate+
entries.description: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain 2 gold. Gain 8 gold now.

entries.name: Worth the Wait
entries.description: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

entries.name: Worth the Wait II
entries.description: Gain 2 copies of a random 2-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

entries.name: Woven Magic
entries.description: Gain a random item component. Every 2200 Mana spent by your champions, grants an additional component (max: 0/3).

entries.name: Young and Wild and Free
entries.description: You can always move freely on Carousel rounds. Gain 5 gold.
